scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @acpio/server" "npm run dev -w @acpio/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:wave1 && npm run build:wave2 && npm run build:wave3
scripts.serve: npm run build:run && npm run start
scripts.build:run: npm run build:wave1 && npm run build:wave2 && npm run build:wave3:run
scripts.build:wave3:run: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -s all -n server,web "npm run build -w @acpio/server" "npm run bundle -w @acpio/web"
scripts.build:wave1: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -s all -n shared,plugin-api,example,ponytail "npm run build -w @acpio/shared" "npm run build -w @acpio/plugin-api" "npm run build -w @acpio/plugin-example" "npm run build -w @acpio/plugin-ponytail"
scripts.build:wave2: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -s all -n i18n,builtin,cursor,omp,opencode "npm run build -w @acpio/i18n" "npm run build -w @acpio/adapter-builtin" "npm run build -w @acpio/adapter-cursor" "npm run build -w @acpio/adapter-omp" "npm run build -w @acpio/adapter-opencode"
scripts.build:wave3: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -s all -n server,web "npm run build -w @acpio/server" "npm run build -w @acpio/web"
